question: Two infinite parallel metal plates are charged with equal surface charge density of the same polarity. The electric field in the gap between the plates is

options.A: inversely proportional to the distance between the plates.
options.B: quadruple the field produced by one plate.
options.D: dependent on the thickness of the plates.
options.E: dependent on coordinates of field points.
options.F: proportional to the square of the distance between the plates.
options.G: double the field produced by one plate.
options.H: half the field produced by one plate.
options.I: triple the field produced by one plate.
options.J: same as that produced by one plate.
